chapter: Chicago clubs, entertainers and tent shows
title: More Chicago names: Mae Brady, Elliott Washington, Bertha Gonzalez
summary: Albertson runs through violinists and a pianist; Cheatham mostly did not know them.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: What about Mae Brady, did you know her?
That name seems to ring a bell.
She was a violinist and she had a
band at the Dreamland for awhile, but it was probably before you came.
Yes. And then, there was another violinist, Elliott Washington.
I remember that name, yes. I remember that name, Elliott Washington, yes.
What about a pianist named Bertha [Gonzalez]?
Is that so? I didn't know her. No.
